remarks: Beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment with incredible 16th-floor views of Long Island Sound and downtown Stamford. This home features hardwood floors throughout, a modern kitchen with white cabinetry, grey quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and a stylish herringbone backsplash. The spacious living and dining area is filled with natural light from wall-to-wall windows, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The large bedroom includes a barn door leading to a walk-in closet, while the double-entry updated bathroom offers an additional linen closet for extra storage. Located in The Biltmore, a premier high-rise condominium, residents enjoy a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle service, community room, laundry room, storage, 4th-flr courtyard, dry cleaning, and a pet-friendly environment. Move-in fee $300. Garage parking is available for $115/mo per car. Conveniently located near I-95, Metro-North, Merritt Parkway, and just steps from the vibrant Bedford Street and Pickleball America, one of the largest indoor pickleball venues in the US, this condo offers the best of city living in the heart of Stamford!
